items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Zolner Randolph was telling me about that infamous episode... [INTERVIEWEE] Right.

ctx.x: Right, or a depot where they could pull it off, right. But they played a lot of major cities and things, and then if they were going to play in the backwoods or something like that, then they'd have to take automobile transportation or something like that, and then come back to the car.
Zolner Randolph was telling me about that infamous episode, when Louis took the big band down to New Orleans and coming back, they stopped in Memphis to get some gas or something --
